commit.subject: build(nx): add Nx task orchestration over the pnpm workspace
commit.body: Add nx and nx.json at the root, delegate root task scripts to nx run-many where a target exists, and ignore the .nx local cache. Establishes the target-exposure convention for future projects. Green and vacuous on the zero-project workspace; pnpm remains the package manager.

commit.subject: build(ts): add strict tsconfig baseline and project-reference root
commit.body: Add tsconfig.base.json with strict mode and the bundler/ESNext/verbatim-module settings every workspace extends, plus a root tsconfig.json that builds the project-reference world (empty for now). Swap the typecheck placeholder for tsc -b. Vacuously green on zero inputs.

commit.subject: build(oxc): add oxlint and oxfmt lint/format toolchain
commit.body: Add the OXC lint/format config at the repo root, an .editorconfig aligned with oxfmt, and swap the lint/format/format:check placeholders for oxlint/oxfmt. Establish the relaxed (fast) and strict (full) lint rulesets, and disable rules that duplicate the strict TypeScript compiler settings. Green on the empty repo.

commit.subject: chore(hooks): add lefthook pre-commit and commit-msg gates
commit.body: Add lefthook with a pre-commit hook running oxlint and oxfmt on staged files and a commit-msg hook validating conventional commits, wired to install on pnpm install via a prepare script. Add CONTRIBUTING.md documenting the commit format and hook stack. Hooks stay under ~3s on small changes.

commit.subject: feat(manifest): add steme workspace config and package manifest schema
commit.body: Add steme.workspace.json declaring the five unit roots, a JSON schema for steme.package.json modeling scopes, scope-nested concepts with referential integrity, publicSurface, and integrations, plus app and package example fixtures and a node-based validate:manifests script (swapping its placeholder). Add docs/CONVENTIONS.md summarizing scopes, concepts, and naming.

phases.title: steme manifest convention and workspace config

commit.subject: feat(sandbox): scaffold apps/sandbox exercising all scopes
commit.body: Scaffold apps/sandbox with a placeholder index.ts per canonical src scope, the pure module-factory/capability/composition skeleton from the composition-root model (Appendix B), and a steme.package.json declaring all scopes and nested concepts. Register it as a root tsconfig project reference. Typechecks and validates against the manifest schema; no real domain code.

commit.subject: feat(example-utility): scaffold first package with public surface
commit.body: Add packages/example-utility with an aligned package.json#exports and steme.package.json#publicSurface, a trivial pure identity function in core, a branded Id Zod schema in contracts, and a sandbox consumer importing it through the public surface only. Resolves as a workspace import without paths hacks.

commit.subject: feat(result): scaffold libraries/result source-owned primitive
commit.body: Add libraries/result with a minimal, self-contained Result/Ok/Err primitive, explicit types, and a README stating what it is and guarantees. Wire it into the typecheck graph and consume it from apps/sandbox by source ownership, proving the libraries folder participates in the root build.

commit.subject: feat(sandbox): wire Drizzle adapter and composition root end to end
commit.body: Add the Drizzle adapter (things schema, typed client, unit-of-work runner, repository) under src/adapters/db/drizzle, a pure things module factory with its ports, the single composition root that chooses the concrete world, the bound capability, and a thin web-rpc entry adapter calling it. Add drizzle.config.ts, the first generated migration outside src/, and .env.example. Swap the db:* placeholders and retire the now-superseded example module. Demonstrates the composition-root decision on real code with the import rules enforced.

phases.title: Database adapter scaffolding and composition root (Drizzle + Postgres)

commit.subject: test(vitest): add root Vitest project mode and first tests
commit.body: Add vitest and @vitest/coverage-v8 with a root project-mode config covering apps, packages, and libraries, plus a test per workspace: the package identity function, the result primitive's guarantee, and a connectionless things-schema shape assertion. Swap the test placeholder and add test:watch. At least three tests pass; no workspace is excluded.

commit.subject: ci(actions): add GitHub Actions full-gate workflow
commit.body: Add .github/workflows/ci.yml running pnpm install --frozen-lockfile then the full gate task set (nx affected -t lint typecheck test build, run-many on main, plus validate:manifests and the db:generate determinism check), with pnpm store and Nx cache restore so unchanged projects are skipped, and a status badge in the README. Green on a feature-branch push; warm runs beat cold.

commit.subject: docs(repo): seed README, CONTRIBUTING, CONVENTIONS, and LICENSE
commit.body: Expand the README (what steme-lab is, the five folders, the commands, the steme-doc pointer), extend CONTRIBUTING (branch/commit conventions, hook stack, package-vs-library-vs-app guidance, promotion path), finalize docs/CONVENTIONS, and add a private all-rights-reserved LICENSE distinct from steme's future MIT so promotion is a conscious license swap. A cold reader can run the repo from the README.
